$comment: Matches and their 24-hour timer (design §3.2.4, §4.2; contracts/v1/state-machines/meet_match.json). A pending match expires if nobody writes before expires_at; the first delivered message makes it active and stops the timer. The countdown is drawn from expires_at; never extend it on the client. M1-PR5 implements it.

meet_swipe_mutual_like.note: wallet is null until the M2 economy is on. A like that does not complete a pair returns matched false and null ids.

rendering.pending: A draining ring to expires_at and the '24h to say hi' pill.
rendering.active: No ring. expires_at is historical once engaged and must not be shown.
rendering.expired_or_closed: Not returned by meet_matches(). A card the caller had open fails with ERR_MEET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND.

reminder.note: Sent once, 3 hours before expiry (meet.match.reminder_hours_before). The push carries ids only: no name, photo or amount reaches a lock screen. The key names here are illustrative; M1-PR5 fixes them.

errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND: Unmatching a match that has closed or that the caller is not in.
errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_CONVERSATION_CLOSED: Writing after expiry, unmatch, block or a moderation decision. The reason is not given to the other side.
